title: 第5章 最好的朋友第6章 陋室不陋
content_zh:
“最好的朋友？”
方多病听见李莲花呐呐自语，仿佛是在记忆里搜寻什么，一时也有些呆愣。冷不防李莲花眯着眼睛凑近自己脸前，吓了一跳，却也不躲闪，就任他这样靠近着打量自己。
不一会儿，李莲花摇着头，又对方多病解释道，“我眼睛现在不太好使，记忆也好像出了一点问题，既然是以前的朋友，那就随我进来坐吧！”
方多病顾忌眼前还有一个陌生的姑娘，只能在心中默默咬牙，“死莲花，竟然敢把本少爷给忘了！等一会儿要你好看。”
“小芳，你也进来吧！”
方多病听见“小芳”二字，不知不觉有点儿恍惚，反应上来是叫那小姑娘。
定睛又见李莲花晃晃悠悠的朝屋中走去，不禁又担心着李莲花除了眼睛出了问题，看着右手好像也不太方便，不知这腿脚是否也有些问题。
等跟着李莲花进了房门，又感叹又心疼，这死莲花不知在这三个月中又平白多遭了多少罪，心中已将肖紫衿骂了个烂透。
这屋子四处漏风，竟还能透过屋顶看见蓝天，屋中摆设也极为简单，一床，一桌，一椅，随便横在堂屋中，桌上也随意摆放了一碟一碗一筷，紧挨着桌子还有一个小小的暖炉。
李莲花是何等精致之人，如若不是身体出了问题，他肯定连一丝灰尘也绝不放过。
家中没有多余的椅子，李莲花只好招待“最好的朋友”坐在椅子上。
眼睛虽然看不太清楚还是转向小芳姑娘，笑着对她说，“小芳，你将手里的东西放在桌上，今天有朋友来寻我，下午就不和你一起去钓鱼了！”
“方大哥，那你午饭怎么办？还是带你朋友去我家吃吧！”小芳就是那日的渔女，她转身就跑，也是回家寻人赶紧救人。
“这位姑娘，多谢你的好意，我带了干粮。”方多病怕李莲花答应，他还有许多话要与李莲花单独说，赶紧抢先回话，“中午，我来解决我们二人的餐食！”
李莲花又看向向方多病，思考了一下，没有拒绝方多病的提议。
“这位朋友，刚听见你喊李莲花，这可是我本来的姓名？”
“嗯！算是吧！”方多病又想了想，却问小芳姑娘，“这位姑娘，你为何喊他’方大哥‘？”
小芳目光在方多病身上晃了晃，看眼前的青年男子样貌俊秀，也不像是坏人，想了想开口答道，“那日我喊人来将方大哥抬回家中，不对，现在应该叫李大哥才对！”
小芳又看了看李莲花，见他面上无反对之意，才又开口说道。
“本也不知道李大哥姓甚名谁，只看他伤的颇重，但口中还反复念叨着’方小宝’这个名字，我们想着这李大哥恐怕也姓方，这’方小宝’要不是李大哥的儿子就是李大哥的弟弟，所以一直也就称他为方大哥啦！”

方多病一听此言，之前心中的闷气不仅一下被一笔勾销，还隐隐生出些欢喜之意，忙从椅子上站起身来，对着小芳姑娘一揖到地，口中称谢，“多谢姑娘搭救我这朋友性命，在下正是方小宝，本名方多病。”
李莲花虽看不清眼前人的动作，耳力却极好，听见这人替自己道谢，不知为何，脸颊也微微透出些红来。
“小芳姑娘，在下还有些不情之请，不知这村中还有好一点的住处嘛？在下愿意花些银钱。”说着要从怀中掏几张银票出来。
“原来如此，这位公子不必多礼，李大哥虽然身体不好，但是这几个月也帮着村民看了不少疾病，可这里已经是村中能住人的房屋中最好的一处了。”
“那请姑娘帮我在村中淘换一些家具，我这朋友的身体……”说着又掏出一锭银子递给小芳姑娘，“要是能有些木板就更好了。”
方多病又打量一眼这四处漏风的居所，虽说心里有些嫌弃，可以李莲花的身体状况和皇帝老儿的态度，想要离开这小渔村也还需要一点时间，要是李莲花的记忆不能恢复，也只好在这隐居几年，暂避风头。
小芳没接方多病的银子，只笑着对方多病说，“李大哥已经将木头准备好了，因为他右手有些不便，那些木头就堆在后院。”
“至于家具，村中实在没有，可以到二十里外的桃源镇置办。”
“好，多谢姑娘！”方多病见这姑娘拒绝了银两，也再未勉强。
二十里不算远，下午骑马去，一来一回，很快就能置办好需要的日常用品，也不知阿飞到哪了？一会儿再给他送一回信。
李莲花就站在一旁听方多病客套，心里在想自己以前究竟是什么人？怎么一点儿记忆也没有，连小芳说的念叨名字这件事也不记得。
别人称呼什么倒是没有关系，也不太重要，方大哥也好，李大哥也好，不过只是一个称呼。
可眼前这个朋友，脱口而出的“李莲花”三个字，他竟觉得无比熟悉，就连院子里那只被称为“狐狸精”的狗也十分熟悉，好像已经陪伴了自己许久。
至于这个“最好的朋友”，李莲花觉得这个称谓应该是真的，心中一点儿也不反感。
可这不符合自己的性格，已经失去记忆，对人才要更加戒备才是，要不然被深山老林里，哭都没地哭！只是不知之前遇到过什么事儿？让自己变成这副模样。
这个叫方多病的朋友一定知道自己的经历，不如先套套他的话，李莲花难得有些失态的想赶人离开。
“小芳姑娘，你赶紧回家吧！别耽误了时间，叫你爹娘担心。”
“好，李大哥。”小芳心中有些惊讶，微微有些失望，只好对方多病说，“方公子，有事可来村中寻我，只要提起我们一家，村里人都会帮忙的。”
方多病对小芳点头示意，等在也看不见这姑娘离开的背影，他急忙回身，一把抓过李莲花右手，给他把脉。
细细探查，见他脉象平缓，碧茶之毒虽未解却无性命之忧，这才放下心来，决定等笛飞声来了，再喂他灵药，最好药魔那老骨头也在场，更有保障。

“老狐狸，你不会是装的吧！”方多病想他病中都在念叨自己的名字，忍不住试探到，“你跑了这么久，就这么想本少爷啊？”
“什么老狐狸，狐狸精的！”李莲花有些无语，这朋友嘴巴好生厉害，“谁给这狗起的名字？这么难听！”
“哼！”方多病哼笑一声，决定先晾他一晾，让他自己郁闷一会，难得有让他不能掌控全局的机会！
决定还是先解决他们二人午饭再说，也不再管屋中呆坐着的人，径直往厨房去，看看这屋中还有什么可吃之物。
李莲花眼中露出一丝迷茫，仿佛在细细思考今天发生的事情，游刃有余的老狐狸此时已不见踪影，只有狐狸精还在小院里晃晃悠悠，到处熟悉新环境。
content_en:
"Best friend?"
Fang Duobing heard Li Lianhua talking to himself, as if he was searching for something in his memory, and was a little dazed for a moment. Unexpectedly, Li Lianhua approached her face with squinted eyes. She was startled, but she didn't dodge, and just let him come closer and look at her.
After a while, Li Lianhua shook her head and explained to Fang Sickly, "My eyes are not working well now, and there seems to be something wrong with my memory. Since we are former friends, please come in and sit with me!"
Fang Duobing was worried that there was a strange girl in front of him, so he could only grit his teeth silently in his heart, "Damn Lotus, how dare you forget about me! I'll make you look good later."
"Xiaofang, come in too!"
When Fang Duobing heard the word "Xiaofang", he was in a trance without realizing it, and his reaction was to call the little girl.
Looking closely, I saw Li Lianhua walking staggeringly towards the house. I couldn't help but worry that in addition to Li Lianhua's eyes, she also seemed to have trouble looking at her right hand. I wonder if there was something wrong with her legs and feet.
When he followed Li Lianhua into the room, he sighed and felt distressed at the same time. He didn't know how many sins this dead Lianhua had suffered in the past three months, and he had scolded Xiao Zijin thoroughly in his heart.
The house was drafty, and you could actually see the blue sky through the roof. The furnishings in the house were extremely simple, with a bed, a table, and a chair randomly placed across the main room. There were also a plate, a bowl, and chopsticks placed randomly on the table, and there was a small heater next to the table.
Li Lianhua is such a delicate person. If there was no physical problem, he would never let go of even a trace of dust.
There were no extra chairs at home, so Li Lianhua had to invite her "best friend" to sit on the chair.
Although he couldn't see clearly, he turned to Miss Xiaofang and said to her with a smile, "Xiaofang, put the things in your hands on the table. A friend came to see me today, so I won't go fishing with you in the afternoon!"
"Brother Fang, what are you going to do for lunch? You'd better take your friends to my house to eat!" Xiaofang was the fisher girl that day. She turned around and ran away. She also went home to look for someone and hurry to save someone.
"Girl, thank you for your kindness. I brought dry food." Fang Duobing was afraid that Li Lianhua would agree. He still had many things to say to Li Lianhua alone, so he quickly replied, "At noon, I will take care of the meals for the two of us!"
Li Lianhua looked at Fang Duobing again, thought for a while, and did not refuse Fang Duobing's proposal.
"My friend, I just heard you call me Li Lianhua. Is this my original name?"
"Yeah! That's right!" Fang Duobing thought about it again, then asked Miss Xiaofang, "Girl, why do you call him 'Brother Fang'?"
Xiaofang's eyes flickered to Fang Duobing. Seeing that the young man in front of her was handsome and didn't look like a bad guy, she thought for a while and replied, "That day I called for someone to carry Brother Fang back home. No, he should be called Brother Li now!"
Xiaofang looked at Li Lianhua again, and saw no objection on his face before speaking again.
"We didn't know Brother Li's last name at first. We just saw that he was seriously injured, but he kept chanting the name 'Fang Xiaobao' repeatedly. We thought that Brother Li might also have the surname Fang. This 'Fang Xiaobao' was either Brother Li's son or Brother Li's younger brother, so we always called him Brother Fang!"
When Fang Duobing heard this, not only was the sullenness in his heart wiped away, but he also felt a hint of joy. He quickly stood up from the chair, bowed to Miss Xiaofang and thanked her, "Thank you very much, Miss, for saving my friend's life. This is Fang Xiaobao, my real name is Fang Duobing."
Although Li Lianhua couldn't see the movements of the person in front of her clearly, her ears were very good. When she heard the person thanking her, for some reason, her cheeks turned slightly red.
"Miss Xiaofang, I would like to extend my merciless invitation. I wonder if there is a better place to live in this village? I am willing to spend some money." As he said this, he took out a few banknotes from his arms.
"I see, this young master doesn't have toDuo Li, although Brother Li is not in good health, he has helped the villagers treat many diseases in the past few months, but this is already the best place in the village that can accommodate people. "
"Then ask the girl to help me buy some furniture in the village. My friend's body..." Then he took out another ingot of silver and handed it to Miss Xiaofang, "It would be better if there were some wooden boards. "
Fang Duobing took another look at the drafty residence. Although he felt a little disgusted, considering Li Lianhua's physical condition and the emperor's attitude, it would take some time to leave this small fishing village. If Li Lianhua's memory could not be restored, he would have to live in seclusion here for a few years to temporarily avoid the limelight.
Xiaofang did not take the money from Fang Duobing, but only smiled at Fang Duobing and said, "Brother Li has prepared the wood. Because he has some difficulty with his right hand, the wood is piled in the backyard. "
"As for furniture, we really don't have any in the village. You can buy it in Taoyuan Town, which is twenty miles away. "
"Okay, thank you girl! "When Fang Duobing saw that the girl refused the silver, he didn't force it anymore.
Twenty miles is not too far. I would ride a horse in the afternoon and come back again and again. I would soon be able to buy the necessary daily necessities. I wonder where A Fei is? Send him a reply later.
Li Lianhua stood aside and listened to Fang Duobing's polite words, thinking in her mind who she was before. Why don't I have any memory at all, not even what Xiaofang said about chanting names.
It doesn't matter what other people call me, it doesn't matter. Whether it's Brother Fang or Brother Li, it's just a title.
But the friend in front of him blurted out the words "Li Lianhua" and he felt extremely familiar to him. Even the dog in the yard called "Vixie" was also very familiar, as if he had been with him for a long time.
As for this "best friend", Li Lianhua felt that this title should be true, and she didn't feel disgusted at all.
But this is not in line with my personality. I have lost my memory, so I need to be more vigilant about talents, otherwise I will be trapped in the mountains and old forests without even crying! I just don’t know what happened before? Let yourself become like this.
This friend named Fang Duobing must know his own experience, so why not try to trick him first? It was rare that Li Lianhua lost his temper and wanted to drive people away.
"Miss Xiaofang, please go home quickly! Don't waste time and worry your parents. "
"Okay, Brother Li. "Xiaofang was a little surprised and slightly disappointed, so she had no choice but to say to Fang Duoying, "Master Fang, if you need anything, come to the village to find me. As long as you mention our family, the villagers will help. "
Fang Duobing nodded to Xiaofang. He couldn't see the girl's leaving figure, so he turned around quickly, grabbed Li Lianhua's right hand, and felt his pulse.
After careful inspection, I saw that his pulse was gentle and that although the poison of Bicha had not been cured, there was no concern for his life. Then I felt relieved and decided to wait for the sound of the flute to come before feeding him the elixir. It would be better if the old bone of the medicine demon was also present, which would be more secure.
"Old fox, you can't be just pretending! Fang Duobing thought that he was murmuring his name even during his illness, so he couldn't help but wonder, "You have been running away for so long, and you miss me so much?" "
"What an old fox, a vixen! Li Lianhua was a little speechless. This friend was so arrogant, "Who named this dog?" So ugly! "
"snort! "Fang Duobing snorted and decided to give him a break first and let him be depressed for a while. It was a rare opportunity for him not to be able to control the overall situation!
He decided to finish lunch for the two of them first, and no longer cared about the people sitting in the room, he went straight to the kitchen to see if there was anything else to eat in the room.
There was a trace of confusion in Li Lianhua's eyes, as if she was thinking carefully about what happened today. The old fox with ease was no longer around. Only the vixen was still wandering around the small courtyard, getting familiar with the new environment.
